question.text: Orchid Buyout Fund II (Cat II) is appointing an independent valuer for quarterly fair-value assessment of its unlisted portfolio companies. Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, what is the minimum experience the independent valuer must have in valuation of unlisted securities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SEBI (AIF) Regulations as summarised in the workbook, independent valuers appointed by AIF Managers should have at least 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities, alongside the broader eligibility criteria for AIF valuers. The Trap: 1 year is below the regulatory threshold. 5 years and 10 years overstate the minimum experience required; they may be useful as internal LP preferences but are not the SEBI minimum for an AIF valuer. Note: The 3-year requirement is a baseline eligibility; managers should also confirm the rest of the SEBI valuer eligibility criteria are met at appointment.
